design_decisions.visual_style: Premium, Industrial, Clean, Professional, Corporate, Trustworthy, Modern B2B
design_decisions.spacing_strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 to p-16 for main sections. Bento layouts should use gap-6 or gap-8. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 to p-8).
design_decisions.layout_strategy: Bento grids for features. Asymmetrical layouts to break up standard blockiness. High-contrast hero section.
design_decisions.component_strategy: Pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (no Shadcn 'Section' components). Use Shadcn UI for interactive elements (Forms, Buttons, Accordeons, Dialogs) heavily customized to match the brand. Avoid soft rounded cards; prefer sharp or max 8px radii to maintain corporate industrial feel.

fonts.heading: Cabinet Grotesk
fonts.installation: Will be loaded via Google Fonts / Fontsource. Cabinet Grotesk needs @fontsource/cabinet-grotesk or similar, IBM Plex Sans via standard.

animations.hover: Transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. Hover states must have higher contrast or lighter hue.
animations.entrance: Staggered fade-up for lists and bento grids using framer-motion.
animations.scroll: Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
